messages:
olivia: heads-up — from the postmortem we saw the same rollout pattern 3x this quarter: a small feature flag ramp then a sudden service error spike during background jobs. I sketched some follow-ups.
raj: ok, share the list. do we have telemetry that ties it to the flag rollout windows?
olivia: partial — traces line up but sampling is inconsistent. action: add flag-tagged traces and correlate with batching windows.
marcus: +1 for better traces. also we should standardize a holdback profile for risky flags (e.g., 0.5% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20%).
sara: agree. add an automated kill-switch if error-rate > threshold during ramp. can we express that as a runbook + config?
lina_pm: want clear owners and timelines. PM will track in the remediation board.
olivia: draft plan below: 1) Flag metadata enrichment (owner, risk, holdback_profile) — owner: raj — due EOW. 2) Signal enrichment (trace tag + flag_id) — owner: marcus — due 2w. 3) Auto-rollback policy + kill-switch for ramps — owner: sara — prototype in 1 week. 4) Post-rollout recurrence detector (detect pattern across releases) — owner: olivia + eng-sre — POC in 3w.
raj: can we make the auto-rollback policy a shared library so both hosted and dedicated paths use same semantics?
marcus: yes — envisioned config like:
```json
{
  "auto_rollback": {
    "window_s": 120,
    "error_rate_pct": 2.0,
    "min_requests": 1000,
    "scope": "flag_id",
    "action": "roll_back_to_previous"
  }
}
```
sara: love that. add a "blast_radius_cap" param so a rollback can't affect > X% of traffic in a single step. e.g., cap to 10% auto changes.
olivia: good call. also want an emergency manual kill switch with one-button in console + slack alert. deploy-bot can post and take action.
lina_pm: timeline check: raj EOW, marcus 2w, sara prototype 1w, olivia POC 3w. Is that realistic?
raj: yes, I'll carve out time.
marcus: need SRE help for sampling changes — pinging eng-sre in the ticket.
sara: prototype will include a simulator to ensure we don't accidentally cascade rollbacks.
olivia: on ownership: add tidy GH issue per item, label "postmortem-action" and assign. PM will follow up weekly until closed.
raj: question: how do we handle dependent flags? if flag B depends on A, rollback A might leave B in broken state. we need dependency metadata.
marcus: agree — extend flag schema with dependencies[]. add check in rollout controller to refuse step >0 if deps not stable.
sara: also propose a small improvement to rollout UI: show projected blast radius per step and warn when above org policy.
olivia: thinking longer term: add anomaly pattern detection that surfaces recurring incident patterns per flag across teams, e.g., "batch-window collisions". that feeds into flag risk score.
lina_pm: PM will add an OKR for "reduce rollout rollback time" and track MTTR for rollouts specifically.
deploy-bot: [automated message] created ticket RF-1123: "Postmortem follow-ups — holdback profiles + auto-rollback" and added assignees: raj, marcus, sara, olivia. :white_check_mark:
marcus: quick note on testing: add a synthetic traffic harness that can reproduce the batch-job spike locally so the auto-rollback can be validated.
raj: will do. also will document the kill-switch runbook steps in runbooks repo.
sara: assigning myself to prototype the rollback logic. will post a design doc tomorrow.
olivia: thanks all. next sync Fri 10am — I'll post the calendar invite. if anyone needs to reassign, update the ticket. :pray:
